Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field. Standard (not 100%) sampling tier - this service is not an Order Saga participant (kart-conventions.md).

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

Mongo._comment: database-design.md's Architecture Exception: this service has no PostgreSQL write side. MongoDB is its sole durable source of truth (tracking_records, tracking_status_history_entries, tracking_status_history_counters, webhook_dedup_entries, tracking_outbox_events).

_comment_Carriers: ddd-model.md Modeling Decision 5: per-carrier status-mapping + SLA-ETA tables are maintained, out-of-band, static reference/configuration data - not aggregates. 'demo-carrier' below is an illustrative example carrier (no real carrier integrations are named anywhere upstream); add a new carrier by adding config here, no code change needed. Carriers is bound as a plain Dictionary<string, CarrierConfig>, so it must contain only real carrier entries - no sibling _comment key.
